about: Review finding F-014 (2026-11-21) as a filesystem corpus. Each case copies unit/ to {work}/unit, generates Go into {work}/out, renames one entry only in case (through a third name, so every volume takes it), and generates again into {work}/out. Afterwards {work}/out must hold exactly the files, names and bytes a first generation of the final unit writes into an empty directory, and a file that is nobody's must be untouched. rename_in is unit or out.
